title: Arizona Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Arizona Small Claims Court (2026): New $5,000 Limit
rank_math_description: Arizona small claims in 2026: the new $5,000 limit (SB 1022), $58 filing in Maricopa, no lawyers, no appeal, the 10-day transfer rule and 10% wage cap.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> justice court precinct -> complaint ($58 Maricopa) -> service -> 20-day answer -> hearing within 60 days -> transfer decision (10 days before) -> hearing -> written judgment within 10 days -> debtor exam / garnishment (10% cap)
